## The problem

What are you trying to build that Tifa makes hard or impossible today?

## Proposed change

What you would like it to do.

## Scope check

Tifa runs a whole app as one pure Go program: no cgo, no Node at runtime, no streaming SSR and no React Server Components (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#scope)). Does this request fit inside that? If it widens it, say why it belongs here.

## Alternatives

Anything you have tried or considered (a setting, a library, a workaround in your app).
